bullets.id: Emas kembali di atas $4.000 setelah turun ke $3.975 pada Jumat, level terendah sejak 20 Juli. Kitco mencatat spot sekitar $4.014,49 (naik 0,50%) Senin karena minyak turun, dan Trading Economics menunjukkan sekitar $4.010 pada Selasa (turun 0,16%). Dalam sebulan emas masih turun 2,54%, sekitar 28,5% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 pada Januari 2026.
bullets.en: Gold is back above $4,000 after falling to $3,975 on Friday, its lowest since July 20. Kitco had spot near $4,014.49 (up 0.50%) on Monday as oil fell, and Trading Economics shows about $4,010 on Tuesday (down 0.16%). Gold is still down 2.54% on the month, about 28.5% below its $5,608.35 record from January 2026.

bullets.id: Brent ditutup turun 0,8% di $115,81 dan WTI sekitar $102. Yield Treasury 10 tahun di bawah 4,98%, turun dari puncak 5,31%. Pasar memperkirakan Fed menahan suku bunga di 3,75–4,00% (peluang sekitar 90%), tetapi CME FedWatch menempatkan peluang kenaikan Desember sekitar 82%. Nowcast Cleveland Fed: PCE inti 3,1% dan PCE umum 3,6% secara tahunan.
bullets.en: Brent settled down 0.8% at $115.81 and WTI was near $102. The 10-year Treasury yield is below 4.98%, down from a 5.31% peak. Markets expect the Fed to hold at 3.75–4.00% (about 90% odds), but CME FedWatch puts the odds of a December hike at about 82%. The Cleveland Fed nowcast has core PCE at 3.1% and headline PCE at 3.6% year on year.

bullets.id: Agenda: durable goods September malam ini 19.30 WIB dan keyakinan konsumen Oktober 21.00 WIB, lalu keputusan Fed Kamis 01.00 WIB dengan konferensi pers Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh, serta PDB kuartal III dan PCE September Kamis 19.30 WIB. Resistance $4.032 dan $4.075 (target $4.160–4.180); support $3.963 dan $3.946 (target $3.890 lalu $3.800).
bullets.en: Agenda: September durable goods tonight at 19:30 WIB and October consumer confidence at 21:00 WIB, then the Fed decision at 01:00 WIB Thursday with a press conference by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, and Q3 GDP and September PCE on Thursday at 19:30 WIB. Resistance at $4,032 and $4,075 (targets $4,160–4,180); support at $3,963 and $3,946 (targets $3,890, then $3,800).

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram naik Rp10.000 ke Rp2.550.000, kenaikan pertama setelah sepekan melemah. Buyback naik Rp10.000 ke Rp2.345.000 (spread Rp205.000, sekitar 8,0%). Galeri24 tetap Rp2.467.000 (buyback Rp2.326.000, spread sekitar 5,7%) dan UBS tetap Rp2.491.000 (buyback Rp2.301.000, spread sekitar 7,6%), jadi selisih Antam dengan Galeri24 melebar ke Rp83.000.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp10,000 to Rp2,550,000, its first rise after a week of declines. Buyback rose Rp10,000 to Rp2,345,000 (a Rp205,000 spread, about 8.0%). Galeri24 stays at Rp2,467,000 (buyback Rp2,326,000, spread about 5.7%) and UBS at Rp2,491,000 (buyback Rp2,301,000, spread about 7.6%), so Antam’s gap over Galeri24 widens to Rp83,000.
